_comment: The stock installer / uninstaller labels on an English-locale device. Measured on the AOSP Android TV images (tv25 API 25, tv30 API 30), whose Google PackageInstaller uses one 'Install' label for a first install *and* an update. The harness matches labels case-insensitively, so the platform's upper-casing (Theme.Material on API 31+) does not matter. The stick is de-DE and uses system.de.json.

installer.fresh_prompt_contains: Do you want to install this application?
installer.update_prompt_contains: Do you want to install an update to this existing application?

uninstaller.prompt_contains: Do you want to uninstall this app?
